description: Erection of a part first floor rear extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CPA/0220/42Dawes/PropSide44 (Rev B); CPA/0220/42Dawes/PropRoof (Rev A); CPA/0220/42Dawes/PropRear (Rev B); CPA/0220/42Dawes/PropSide40 (Rev B)
Received:  28 May 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be installed into the first floor rear extension hereby approved.
